output_text: Do not create verification scripts or tinker when tests cover that functionality and prove it works. Stick to existing directory structure - don't create new base folders without approval. Do not change the application's dependencies without approval. You must only create documentation files if explicitly requested by the user. Use the `search-docs` tool to search for Laravel-ecosystem documentation before falling back to other approaches. Search the documentation before making code changes. Do not add package names to queries. Always use curly braces for control structures, even if it has one line. Use PHP 8 constructor property promotion in `__construct()`. Do not allow empty `__construct()` methods with zero parameters. Always use explicit return type declarations for methods and functions. Never use comments within the code itself unless there is something _very complex going on_. Use `php artisan make:` commands to create new files. Pass `--no-interaction` to all Artisan commands.
